answer: The European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) deliberately did not issue its 2024 generative AI guidelines in its role as AI Supervisor of the EU institutions under the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act. Instead, a separate strategy is being prepared for that capacity. The guidelines published by the EDPS in 2024 focus solely on helping EU institutions comply with data protection obligations under Regulation (EU) 2018/1725 and are issued within its role as independent data protection authority of the EU institutions.
